title: The Monthly Settlement Cycle is the ecosystem's clock, synchronising six otherwise independent processes
content:
A.2.4 introduces the Monthly Settlement Cycle as "a recurring process that synchronizes core financial operations, governance functions, and risk management activities across the ecosystem," and A.2.4.1.1 enumerates six processes it aligns: Treasury Management allocation of the prior month's Net Revenue; settlement of the monthly SRC origination, where "the clearing price is established, costs are deducted from winning Prime Agents' accounts, and their accounts are credited with Originated SRC"; processing of queued USDS/srUSDS conversions; funding of Pioneer Incentive Pools; updating Smart Burn Engine parameters "based on the prior month's state"; and Core GovOps functions including "payment/reimbursement processing, compliance monitoring, and the calculation and application of retroactive penalties."

Batching these to a common cadence is what makes them mutually consistent. Each consumes or produces figures the others need — penalties adjust amounts due, origination settlement changes capital positions, Treasury allocation depends on the resulting Net Revenue — so running them on independent schedules would guarantee that some process always operates on stale inputs.

A discrete cycle also creates something the ecosystem otherwise lacks: a defined point at which a month's state is *closed*. The dispute, resolution and true-up machinery in A.2.4.1.2.1 only makes sense against fixed periods with boundaries, and retroactive penalties need a settled interval to be applied to.

The costs are the familiar ones of batch processing. Queued conversions wait up to a month, penalties accrue continuously but are applied discretely, and the cycle itself becomes a critical path — a delay in the Final Calculation delays payments to every Prime Agent at once. A.2.4.1.2 also notes the initial implementation "does not include the Senior Risk Capital System, which is still being developed," so one of the six is not yet running.
description: Revenue allocation, SRC origination settlement, srUSDS queue processing, Pioneer pool funding, Smart Burn Engine parameter updates and retroactive penalty application all land in one monthly window.
